redactions.reason: Bystanders in any released footage are blurred by default.
Licence plates in any street footage.
Names, addresses and phone numbers on any document shown.

foia_suggestions: For a real case episode: request body-worn and dash camera recordings and the evidence log from the investigating agency under the state public records law; record request number, date, exemptions claimed and appeal path in the FOIA log.
Request court exhibits only where they were shown in open court; never request sealed or juvenile records.
